No repository cipher/helper/verifier functions are imported. Certificate summaries are checked only after per-record counts, domains and event ledgers are established.

A newly completed package enters only after its frame family, source mapping, repair classifications and displayed reading have been reviewed. Extend the explicit package list and replace the expected ledger only with that reviewed result; no directory discovery or automatic expected-value refresh is performed.
The --verify command reads inputs, certificates, keys and this manifest without writing any file. --emit prints a fresh candidate ledger for review and also never overwrites the manifest.
